name: AgentMonitor Demo 2
description: Forward OpenClaw runtime hook events to the local AgentMonitor demo-2 service and enforce tool-call decisions.

enabled.description: Enable AgentMonitor Demo 2 hook forwarding and enforcement.

monitorUrl.description: Base URL for the AgentMonitor Demo 2 service.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for the before_tool_call enforcement path.

failClosedOnError.description: Block tool calls when the monitor is unavailable or returns an invalid response.

observeHooks.description: Forward non-blocking observation hooks such as llm_input, llm_output, after_tool_call, and message_sending.

auditOnly.description: Record monitor decisions but never enforce block or approval responses.

enabled.label: 启用监控
enabled.help: 开启 OpenClaw hook 事件转发和工具调用实时控制（Demo 2）。

monitorUrl.label: 监控服务地址
monitorUrl.help: AgentMonitor demo-2 服务地址，默认 http://127.0.0.1:19877。

timeoutMs.label: 实时检查超时
timeoutMs.help: before_tool_call 的 HTTP 超时时间。建议保持在 100ms 以内。

failClosedOnError.label: 故障时阻断
failClosedOnError.help: 监控服务不可用时阻断工具调用，避免安全系统失效后静默放行。

observeHooks.label: 采集观察类事件
observeHooks.help: 采集模型输入输出、工具结果和消息发送事件。

auditOnly.label: 仅审计
auditOnly.help: 只记录决策，不真正阻断或触发审批。
